topic: the two-part message Jinbe left Luffy on Fish-Man Island shows he was protecting Luffy before he joined
title: Jinbe Left Luffy One Message On Fish-Man Island
description: When Luffy reaches Fish-Man Island, Jinbe is already gone. All he left behind was a two part message through the princes. Here is what Do not fight Hody and I'll be waiting in the Sea Forest really said.
comment: Was Jinbe warning Luffy off Hody to protect him, or to protect Fish-Man Island?

lines.text: Jinbe left Luffy a two part message before he vanished.

shot.fallback: fish-man leaving a note on a shore

lines.text: Luffy arrives expecting his friend, and Camie says Jinbe already left. Chapter 609.

shot.fallback: mermaid telling a boy his friend is gone

lines.text: Then the princes pass on his words. The first half is simple: do not fight Hody.
The second half is, I'll be waiting in the Sea Forest.
Think about that order. He doesn't say sorry I missed you. He warns Luffy away from a fight first.

shot.fallback: fish-man warning a boy with a serious look

lines.text: And the Sea Forest holds Queen Otohime's grave, with Jinbe waiting in front of it. Chapter 615.
He chose the spot that stands for the dream he shares with her.

shot.fallback: queen of an underwater kingdom smiling

lines.text: When Luffy turns up with Shirahoshi, Jinbe is so stunned his eyes bug out of his head.

shot.fallback: fish-man with eyes popping in shock

lines.text: A man who plans this carefully for a friend is never casual about saying yes.

shot.fallback: fish-man and boy standing side by side

lines.text: So why did he still tell Luffy not yet when the invitation finally came?
Because Jinbe left Luffy a message before he vanished, and the first line was a warning...

shot.fallback: fish-man leaving a note on a shore

self_check.hook: line 1 names Jinbe and the claim
